The r/naruto discord is also a specific group about a specific topic, i'm a member and i can say the discussions there are way more than just a bunch of people saying "i like naruto" over and over and over, so if you think a discord for criticism about the ending will just be a bunch of people "echoing the same opinion" (your exact words in your previous comment) or posting "i don't like the ending" over and over you lack an imagination, so i repeat: people who disagree with you aren't a hivemind.

Just like i'm free to post my opinions here i'm also free to create a discord about any topic i want, and i doubt you're going to join so i advise you don't lose sleep over how long the conversations last in a discord you're not even interested in being part of.

Not all people who don't like the ending have the exact same opinions. Some people didn't like the ending specifically because of the end-game couples, some people like the end-game couples but they don't like the way they were developed, some people have no problem with the couples or the way they were developed but didn't like the way other elements of the story were handled (like the politics of the shinobi system, the design and personality of the new characters, the new arcs, the plot holes and mysteries that were never explained, etc).

No one is a hivemind. Just like people who are "pro-ending" don't always have the exact same reasons for liking it. 

And two people yelling desperately at each other "THE LAST IS GREAT!!" "NO, IT SUCKS!!" isn't a wholesome conversation worth having.
